default_message.description: Problem message text. This no longer works from Zabbix 5.0 onwards.

default_subject.description: Problem message subject. This no longer works from Zabbix 5.0 onwards.

event_source.description: Type of events that the action will handle.

recovery_message.description: Recovery message text. This no longer works from Zabbix 5.0 onwards.

recovery_subject.description: Recovery message subject. This no longer works from Zabbix 5.0 onwards.

update_message.description: Update operation message text. This no longer works from Zabbix 5.0 onwards.

update_subject.description: Update operation message subject. This no longer works from Zabbix 5.0 onwards.

authentication_type.description: Type Of Authentication to Use LDAP Must be configure before using this field

data_type.description: Data type of the item (Removed in Zabbix 3.4).

delta.description: Value that will be stored (Removed in Zabbix 3.4).

history.description: Number of days to keep item's history data. From 3.4 version, string is required instead of integer. Default: 90 (90d for 3.4+).

host_id.description: ID of the host or template that the item belongs to.

snmp_oid.description: SNMP OID , Used only with SNMP.

trapper_host.description: Allowed hosts. Used only by trapper items.

trends.description: Number of days to keep item's trends data. From 3.4 version, string is required instead of interger. Default: 365 (365d for 3.4+).

units.description: SNMP OID , Used only with SNMP.

data_type.description: Data type of the item prototype (Removed in Zabbix 3.4).

delta.description: Value that will be stored (Removed in Zabbix 3.4).

history.description: Number of days to keep item's history data. Default: 90.

host_id.description: ID of the low level discovery that the item prototype belongs to.

dependencies.description: ID of the trigger it depends
ID of the trigger it depands

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported value maps to already existing ones. Used only for value maps on templates. Auto-generated, if not given

compare_version.description: Version to compare the Zabbix server version to.

server_version_ge.description: Returns true if the version of the Zabbix server is greater or equal to the version provided in `compare_version`.

server_version_gt.description: Returns true if the version of the Zabbix server is strictly greater than the version provided in `compare_version`.

server_version_le.description: Returns true if the version of the Zabbix server is less or equal to the version provided in `compare_version`.

server_version_lt.description: Returns true if the version of the Zabbix server is strictly less than the version provided in `compare_version`.

unit_time_days.description: String representation of the days unit used by the Zabbix server (`d` for version 3.4+, empty string otherwise).

unit_time_hours.description: String representation of the hours unit used by the Zabbix server (`h` for version 3.4+, empty string otherwise).

unit_time_minutes.description: String representation of the minutes unit used by the Zabbix server (`m` for version 3.4+, empty string otherwise).

unit_time_seconds.description: String representation of the seconds unit used by the Zabbix server (`s` for version 3.4+, empty string otherwise).

unit_time_weeks.description: String representation of the weeks unit used by the Zabbix server (`w` for version 3.4+, empty string otherwise).
